scores.rationale: Secrets are typed/redacted and rejected from persistence, worker/API/frontend boundaries are explicit, OpenAPI/UI are GET-only, and no mutation call is present. Runtime container enforcement remains externally unverified.

Past-stale and future-dated required sources fail closed; future/stale price and depth events are audited without live promotion; reconciliation, segmented pagination, calendar blocking, reconnect backoff, and readiness ordering are covered. Real Groww behavior remains unverified.

Universe selection, event-time 1m candles, finalized 5m provenance, late/duplicate handling, SQL idempotency, Redis TTLs, and rebuild logic are implemented and locally tested. Real PostgreSQL/Redis execution is blocked.

Eight read endpoints, fail-closed market/account/option responses, localhost topology, status-first accessible dashboard, valid UTF-8 text, and runnable operating docs exist. Compose execution remains blocked.

All available backend, OpenAPI, UI-safety, frontend render/build, dependency, stale/future-source, reconnect, and worker trust-boundary checks pass. Seven Docker/live skips are explicit external blockers with runnable gates.
